description: This file defines the FrameTree class and related classes for managing browser frames, browsing contexts, WebSocket events, and worker debuggers in Firefox. It handles frame creation, navigation, WebSocket events, worker lifecycle, and event emission within a browser automation or debugging context.

classes.name: FrameTree
classes.description: Manages the hierarchy of browser frames, browsing contexts, WebSocket events, and worker debuggers, emitting events for navigation, frame attachment/detachment, and WebSocket activity.

classes.name: IsolatedWorld
classes.description: Represents an isolated JavaScript execution context within a frame, with scripts to evaluate and bindings.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a single browser frame, manages its execution contexts, WebSocket events, navigation state, and bindings.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a dedicated web worker, manages its debugger, messaging, and lifecycle.

methods.name: setInitScripts
methods.description: Sets scripts to evaluate on new documents within isolated worlds.

methods.name: _ensureWorld
methods.description: Ensures an isolated world exists for a given name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: _frameForWorker
methods.description: Retrieves the frame associated with a worker debugger.

methods.name: _onDOMWindowCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of a new DOM window, initializing its frame.

methods.name: setJavaScriptDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables JavaScript execution in all frames.

methods.name: _onWorkerCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of a new worker debugger, creating a Worker instance.

methods.name: _onWorkerDestroyed
methods.description: Handles destruction of a worker debugger, disposing of the Worker instance.

methods.name: allFramesInBrowsingContextGroup
methods.description: Returns all frames within a browsing context group.

methods.name: isPageReady
methods.description: Checks if the page is marked as ready.

methods.name: forcePageReady
methods.description: Marks the page as ready and emits the PageReady event.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript binding to all frames.

methods.name: frameForBrowsingContext
methods.description: Retrieves the frame associated with a browsing context.

methods.name: frameForDocShell
methods.description: Retrieves the frame associated with a document shell.

methods.name: frame
methods.description: Retrieves a frame by its ID.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns all frames in the main frame's hierarchy.

methods.name: mainFrame
methods.description: Returns the main frame.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the FrameTree, removing listeners and disposing resources.

methods.name: onWindowEvent
methods.description: Handles window events such as DOM element insertion and navigation.

methods.name: _frameNavigationCommitted
methods.description: Handles actions after a frame's navigation is committed.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Handles progress state changes during navigation.

methods.name: onLocationChange
methods.description: Handles location change events for frames.

methods.name: _onBrowsingContextAttached
methods.description: Handles new browsing contexts being attached.

methods.name: _onBrowsingContextDetached
methods.description: Handles browsing contexts being detached.

methods.name: _createFrame
methods.description: Creates a new Frame instance for a browsing context.

methods.name: _detachFrame
methods.description: Detaches and disposes of a frame.
